description: Of two reference-resolution errors of DIFFERENT types (an unresolved reference on line 1, a mapping-in-interpolation error on line 4), the one at the lowest source position is thrown — not whichever the parser's internal traversal happens to reach first. Mapping-in-interpolation is checked inline during resolution while unresolved-reference is only checked in a final pass, so a naive implementation reports line 4 here instead of line 1.
